title: Applying CSS styles to connectMenu item removes "isRefined" functionality
body:
Hi! I took for example this tutorial from official documentation: [Customize widgets](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/guides/customization.html)

Remade it to suit my needs, basically just changed `<select>` to `<ul>` and `<option>` to `<li>`.

Now when trying to customize `<li>` (which is connectMenu Item) through CSS, somehow magically "isRefined" stop working and does not apply class to `<li>`. I spent like 2 days figuring out and coming up to this point.
